title: Audit: bind retained PR589 supplier identity and COPY deficit
head: 1356813dddd0e03ea138743a799c2aece15f7d44
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR #1277 leaves a concrete next question: can the retained PR589 supplier identity be bound when an assembly preserves its accepted numbers but names a false commit/blob? This adds an **opt-in source-binding guard**, confined to `research/retained-bit-supplier-binding/`. The finding and broader ancestry-equality repair remain Sagar Thakrar’s; this is the complementary executable guard.

The guard checks the exact PR589 record and compressed word across the contributor’s original `research/e8-bit-p111/` path, the integration commit, and main’s renamed `research/e8-bit-p111-tuned/` path. It independently follows D/A frame assignments and ranks the nine COPY frames over Q: nine rank-seven totals, decoder constant 63, and `64*28416 - 1808352 = 32*(8*111 - 9*63) = 10272`. All four committed PR741/799/1042/1094 assemblies and the archived bit result pass.

`--assembly` and `--bit-result` guard newly emitted outputs against that exact source; an optional receipt hashes the exact byte snapshots checked. False provenance, a same-blob different real commit, compensating COPY ranks and a mass-preserving histogram change are rejected. The implementation imports no supplier/frame/moment checker and runs under `-I -O -B`.

**No new κ, circuit, paid-profile change or production adoption.** Existing verifiers, frozen inputs and the selected record are unchanged. The frame trace measures COPY ranks only; it does not establish scalar/frame legality or H1–H5. Recorded profile/budget fields remain inputs. No full cold/native/scalar/phase replay, certified moment, all-size/compiler, hosting, precision/tape, exact-recovery or analytic proof is claimed. PR1277’s original acceptance fixture is credited, not freshly replayed here. Both this guard and its broader ancestry-equality repair would be needed in a successor wrapper.

No pending PR is a code dependency.
- Refreshed public API snapshot at **2026-10-13 22:42:31 UTC**: 815 open PRs including drafts, complete PR pagination; repository helper searched titles/bodies and local top-level notes/ledger. Start-here, active listing and live handoff Discussion were read. Complete Discussion pagination was unavailable; browser was signed out and the GitHub connector has no Discussion-write tool, so the claim is local. Arbitrary diffs/closed PRs are not exhaustively searched; no novelty proof is claimed.

## Validation

Windows 11, CPython **3.12.14**, standard library plus Git:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/retained-bit-supplier-binding --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/retained-bit-supplier-binding
python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py
git diff --cached --check
```

All pass. Registered replay includes the deterministic receipt plus **10 test groups / 23 rejection fixtures**, actual CLI rejection and relocated-input/source-corruption checks. The card’s historical owner-boundary positive control also passes. The final package replay was rerun after the receipt-byte-snapshot change.

The broader `test_research_*.py` suite ran 20 tests and reported **3 Windows errors in unchanged tests**: missing `os.killpg` on the deliberate timeout path, plus temporary-directory cleanup errors. Process-local `core.autocrlf=false` and workspace scratch directories were used. This is recorded as a failed broader suite, not a pass; package checks succeed separately.
